Our Capital Projects Group workforce is made up of driven and dedicated professionals who care deeply about working together to deliver infrastructure and make a positive impact in our communities. Join us as we build a knowledgeable and collaborative team that courageously changes how transit projects will be delivered. Our Capital Projects Group is seeking a Senior Scheduler who develops and maintains assigned capital project schedules and provides various complex planning and scheduling activities throughout the project life cycle to properly deploy resources, tightly manage schedule, maintain the integrity of the program plan, provide analysis for activity scenarios, provide corridor schedule narrative, and adhere to the financial and business processes. Our Capital Projects Group is seeking a Senior Scheduler who develops and maintains assigned capital project schedules and provides various complex planning and scheduling activities throughout the project life cycle to properly deploy resources, tightly manage schedule, maintain the integrity of the program plan, provide analysis for activity scenarios, provide corridor schedule narrative, and adhere to the financial and business processes. What will I be doing? Implement procurement strategies and delivery models, including PDB, AFP, DBB, DBF, and P3 lifecycle approaches in the schedule development process. Conduct schedule progress analysis, performance monitoring, and risk assessments; regularly update schedules throughout all project phases from planning through completion and close-out. Review, challenge, validate, and provide comments on contractor, consultant, and external stakeholder schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements, scheduling standards, and contractual obligations before incorporation into the master schedule. Analyze critical and near-critical paths, schedule float consumption, schedule trends, productivity impacts, delays, disruptions, and root causes; identify mitigation measures, recovery strategies, and opportunities to accelerate work completion. Implement schedule change management processes and integrate estimating, forecasting, and risk management strategies into project schedules. Prepare and maintain program-wide progress measurement and reporting systems, including progress roll-up structures, weighting methodologies, performance metrics, KPIs, and reporting calendars. Prepare schedule status reports, dashboards, executive presentations, and schedule narratives, and communicate project performance information to key stakeholders while maintaining confidentiality and data integrity. Lead schedule reviews and status assessments throughout all project phases with project teams, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders. Facilitate schedule integration workshops, constructability sequencing reviews, and interface coordination sessions with project teams, contractors, utilities, municipalities, and external stakeholders to identify and mitigate schedule risks and dependencies. Integrate multiple project schedules into program-level master schedules and identify interface risks, dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and project interrelationships. Work closely with project estimators, cost analysts, and project controls teams to integrate schedules with forecasts, cost management, cash flow projections, earned value management, and performance reporting. Provide earned value management analysis and project controls support to facilitate effective project decision-making. Conduct schedule health assessments, independent schedule reviews, and quality reviews to ensure compliance with organizational scheduling standards, governance requirements, industry best practices, and contractual obligations. Provide technical support and share scheduling expertise with project teams, project controls professionals, and stakeholders on CPM scheduling methodologies and schedule analysis techniques. Leverage digital project controls systems and data analytics tools to enhance schedule reporting, forecasting accuracy, and project performance insights. Interpersonal and oral/written communication skills to liaise with project team members, external agencies, and consultants and prepare tender comparisons, post-bid analyses, and other estimating information, and to facilitates data and information sharing and between internal and external stakeholders Don’t Meet Every Requirement? review_candidates.title: Postdoctoraal onderzoeker Afrika Studies
review_candidates.description: Omvang: 1 FTE, duur: 2 jaar Het Afrika-Studiecentrum Leiden (ASCL) is op zoek naar een postdoctoraal onderzoeker voor het project “Afrikaanse Actoren in de Russisch-Oekraïense oorlog”. Dit postdoc-project is onderdeel van het onderzoeksproject naar Afrikaanse vrede en veiligheid dat door het Afrika-Studiecentrum Leiden met de Kennishub Afrika van de Nederlandse Defensie Academie (NLDA) wordt beheerd en begeleid. Projectbeschrijving De veiligheid en ontwikkeling van Afrikaanse staten en bevolkingen zijn sterk verweven met geopolitieke conflicten elders in de wereld, aan hun grenzen of zelfs binnen hun grenzen. Bij de Russische invasie van Oekraïne lijken Afrikaanse actoren opnieuw speelbal te zijn van een soort ‘Koude Oorlog-dynamiek’. Het Afrikaanse continent wordt hard geraakt door de negatieve effecten van de oorlog. De invloed van Afrikaanse actoren op de Russisch-Oekraïense oorlog krijgt echter weinig aandacht, terwijl Afrikaanse landen en organisaties een diepe economische, politieke, en militaire verwevenheid hebben met dit conflict. In de strijd om steun in de Verenigde Naties navigeren Afrikaanse landen de gunsten van Rusland en Oekraïne, duizenden Afrikaanse huurlingen strijden in de frontlinie in Oekraïne, Rusland en Oekraïne steunen verschillende Afrikaanse strijdkrachten, en een delegatie van de Afrikaanse Unie bracht een bezoek aan Poetin en Zelensky om een Afrikaans vredesplan te presenteren. Dat roept een aantal belangrijke vragen op: Hoe navigeren Afrikaanse staten en andere politieke en gewapende actoren de geopolitieke strijd rondom de toekomst van Oekraïne? Welke rol speelt de geschiedenis van kolonialisme en eerdere oorlogen in hun keuzen en (in)acties? Hoe gebruiken Afrikaanse landen hun groeiende stem in de wereld om de oorlog, en het perspectief op vrede, te beïnvloeden?
